coverage_interpretation.not_represented: retained as an empirical coverage gap; never silently removed
coverage_interpretation.ontology_term_support: Gate-D conceptual elements referenced by at least one represented or partial source requirement
coverage_interpretation.incremental_coverage: new unique CM-PharmE ontology targets contributed by each source in the frozen source_order; descriptive and order-dependent

mandatory_conditions: all registry rows have a valid status and requirement type
all represented/partial CM-PharmE targets resolve in the frozen ontology
every source in source_order has at least one registered requirement
concept and relation denominators are explicit
no global-domain-completeness conclusion is inferred from source coverage
v1_comparison_boundary: Use the existing W3 V1→V2 migration matrix for qualitative novelty/continuity accounting. Do not invent a quantitative V1 source-semantic coverage percentage because no equivalent frozen V1 source-requirement registry exists.
